ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms recovery steps, an exercise schedule and the ownerless-runbook flag are declared; it does not show the runbook was ever exercised.
offer: A disaster-recovery runbook needs ordered steps, an owner and scheduled exercises. A document that has never been exercised cannot establish actual recoverability.

minimal.reason: Write the ordered recovery steps. An unordered runbook fails under pressure, so list each step in sequence.

mid.reason: Declare how often the runbook is exercised. A document never exercised cannot establish recoverability, so set a schedule.

maximal.reason: Set runbook without owner to false. An ownerless runbook goes stale, so name the accountable person or team.

rule.reason: Write the ordered recovery steps. An unordered runbook fails under pressure, so list each step in sequence.
